item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We refuse to accept that future. We must stop its development before the choice is taken out of our hands.

2. We cannot protect humanity while racing to build the technology that will end it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We demand a halt to that race.

3. We stand for a future with people in it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. No promised breakthrough justifies that outcome. We must stop it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We begin with the truth that drives our work: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We will not dress that outcome up as a manageable risk or an acceptable price for progress. We reject a race that puts every person, every community and every future generation on the line. Our task is to stop the development of superintelligent AI before it ends humanity. We demand binding limits, meaningful enforcement and the political courage to put human survival ahead of corporate ambition. We have a future to defend, and we intend to defend it together.
